div.div: I added a function to automagically pull in the TSV to numpy without a header in 3 calls: aed809331 There was a problem with the censors shifting by 1 place in Tproject Do you remember the issue? AFNI specifically requires TSVs to have a single header row (and no header row or header rows that start with # for .1D files): If you mix .1D and .tsv files, the number of data rows in each file must be the same. Since the header row in a .tsv file is NOT used here, the total number of lines in a .tsv file must be 1 more than the number of lines in a .1D file for the two files to match in this program. The crash this PR is addressing looks like Cmdline: 3dTproject -input /ocean/projects/med250004p/shared/regression_outputs_v1.8.8/benchmark-FNIRT/KKI/sub-3884955/working/pipeline_benchmark-FNIRT/cpac_pipeline_benchmark-FNIRT_sub-3884955_ses-1/nuisance_regression_space-native_reg-Regressor_3_247/_scan_rest_run-1_acq-2/nuisance_regression/sub-3884955_ses-1_task-rest_acq-2_run-1_bold_resample_calc_tshift_volreg_calc_maths.nii.gz -cenmode KILL -censor /ocean/projects/med250004p/shared/regression_outputs_v1.8.8/benchmark-FNIRT/KKI/sub-3884955/working/pipeline_benchmark-FNIRT/cpac_pipeline_benchmark-FNIRT_sub-3884955_ses-1/nuisance_regression_space-native_reg-Regressor_3_247/offending_timepoints_connector/_scan_rest_run-1_acq-2/find_offending_time_points/censors.tsv -mask /ocean/projects/med250004p/shared/regression_outputs_v1.8.8/benchmark-FNIRT/KKI/sub-3884955/working/pipeline_benchmark-FNIRT/cpac_pipeline_benchmark-FNIRT_sub-3884955_ses-1/_scan_rest_run-1_acq-2/func_get_brain_mask_AFNI_130/sub-3884955_ses-1_task-rest_acq-2_run-1_bold_resample_calc_tshift_volreg_mask.nii.gz -ort /ocean/projects/med250004p/shared/regression_outputs_v1.8.8/benchmark-FNIRT/KKI/sub-3884955/working/pipeline_benchmark-FNIRT/cpac_pipeline_benchmark-FNIRT_sub-3884955_ses-1/nuisance_regressors_Regressor_3_189/_scan_rest_run-1_acq-2/build_nuisance_regressors/nuisance_regressors.1D -polort 0 -prefix residuals.nii.gz (24 more lines were trimmed) and we've seen this issue before (#1265, #1268, #1327)

If we don't want / care to allow for generating-but-not-applying, then yeah, I think just one switch makes sense. Otherwise, I just think
it's not clear that run generates but doesn't apply, and apply_func_mask_in_template_space is unnecessarily long.
But those are just my opinions. I think with some comments saying what the options do, these keys can work fine.

div.div: Pytests: getting error function uses no argument error
singularity run error: No valid /bin/sh in container
For me this suggestion did the trick: when changing Singularity versions, configuration, or installation path, run make clean between make and make install in the installation process.
